text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- First Russian exhibition to be held in Bahrain later this year. Around 500 Russian firms to take part in the event.
- Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait to finance a 250,000 dinar pedestrian bridge in Manama to be completed next year.
- Bahraini, Jordanian and Egyptian officials meet in New York and discuss ways of boosting cooperation in the fields of environment and development.
- United Arab Shipping Co net profits were $70 million in 1996, down $17.2 million from 1995.
